mission.title: Precious Bodily Fluids
mission.description: Obtain a fluid sample from the captured Unlimit lieutenant Beirn.

npc.say: Get this creature away from me!
Was there ever a tale more tragic than that of Beirn and Persephone? What will become of us now, my love? With this world is against us, must we wait for the next?
Come on, you've got to admit that would be totally awesome!
It is the classic "miracle in a bottle"; nothing will come of it.
There are other fluids I would prefer to analyze.

phase.briefing:
Managed to drag yourself out of your usual sodden stupor for a moment, eh? Well, if you've been paying attention, you know that we captured Beirn, Anome's resident Persephone pervert. If I recall correctly, you met him before, or at least got close to him, n'est-ce pas? So go talk to him now and see what you can get out of him. We've got him in a holding pen with code inhibitors running at the highest possible capacity.
If you start to get a bloody nose while you're in there, don't worry, it's a perfectly normal side effect of the inhibitors, probably harmless...

enter.say: That should be the spot. I can't really get a solid reading with all the code inhibitors in the area. Man, look at those signal levels! This must be costing the Merv a pretty penny.

talk.say: Gah! Is this the end for Beirn? So close to paradise, yet so far! Oh, you fiends! You devils! You've never known what love is, and you never will! Damn you to hell!

done.say: Oh...kay. He seems a little on edge, I would say. I don't think we're going to get anything out of him in that state. See what the doctor there has to say.
Your words are as empty as your soul! If I had my power, I'd rip your dead eyes from their sockets and grind them beneath my heel! Begone!

talk.say: Although the inhibitors prevent him from using his abilities, in his agitated state, his body is still resistant to our probes. We're having a difficult time getting any kind of data from him, much less an actual fluid sample.

done.say: Oh, great. I'm sure Flood will just be tickled to hear this.

phase.briefing:
So nothing can be had from our captive ape while he beats his chest and bewails his lost love, eh? If I cared, I might make some sort of comment on the fascinating power of what you call "love." Fortunately, I don't care a fig for such trite tracasseries.
I see one solution for this: Persephone. Yes, I must admit that this one time, she does have a use. But if he is to meet her, we'll need to transfer Beirn to a more reliable holding pen. While I attend to these vital tasks, operative, I have a simple one for you: eliminate the Unlimit nearby. They've been tracking Beirn, and will no doubt attempt some sort of ambush during the transfer unless they are taken care of.

enter.say: You know what? I think Flood needs a girlfriend.

done.say: Looks clear. Flood should have no trouble transferring Beirn.

phase.briefing: Beirn has been transferred to a more secure prison with permanent code inhibitors in place. Persephone should be arriving momentarily. Get in there and get something useful out of him for once!

enter.say: Now we see if Persephone can straighten his cornrows.

talk.say: If I'm hurt, my husband will have your balls!

No, no! Can't she see that everything I've done, everything I've sacrificed, has been for her? This power, trapping myself in the Matrix--all for her!
Yet she scorns me--despises me. I am near her now, but with these code inhibitors in place, I can't show her that I am worthy of her. Oh, cruel fate!

done.say:
Wow. I don't know about you, but I'm getting a little misty here.
Or...not. It doesn't sound like we'll be getting much in the way of useful info from Romeo there, but maybe the docs have been able to get something now that she's slapped him down. Check and see.

objective.text: Get the sample from Deonna Raikov

talk.say: The subject has been docile enough that we were able to get a sample from him, once we found a sufficiently strong needle. I have the sample here.

done.say: Yes, this sample should be taken to our lab for examination.
All right. We'll see where Flood wants that.

phase.briefing:
What did you say? You actually obtained a result? I thought it was an unusually cold day in the Hel Club; now I know why.
Take it to the lab, of course. Don't try drinking it, or any such foolishness.

enter.say: The lab is in there. You'll need to talk to Chief Technician Allemeier.

talk.say: Put the sample in the scanning computer, please.

objective.text: Put the sample in the scanning computer

done.say: ... Guess that's it. Probably would have been more interesting to have drunk it. I mean, just one little sip couldn't have hurt, right?

complete.say: I believe your work here is done, operative. Please don't touch anything on your way out.

mission.finish:
Ah. Now it is only a matter of time...
You see? My careful planning has done what all the armies in the Matrix could not. I knew chasing after the case was a waste of energy. There's a lesson for you in this, {player}.
